description: Ocean Acidification Curriculum Collection is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Suquamish Tribe; Washington Sea Grant; NOAA Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory. Access a database of freely available articles and K-12 lesson plans on ocean acidification and related topics. The collection is searchable by grade band, activity type, and ocean acidification principle. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
